title: The Summer Hikaru Died
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a rural Japanese town, teenager Yoshiki realizes his best friend Hikaru died in the mountains and that something else now wears his form. He chooses to keep the secret and stay close to the being, while old local curses and people who hunt such entities close in.
life_message: A good life faces grief honestly and learns which attachments to keep and which to let go.

content.note: A murder, a stabbing and a decapitation; brief bloody corpses (Wikipedia; Common Sense Media on the anime: violence 'a lot').
Sustained cosmic and body horror, the entity offering parts of its body (Wikipedia; CSM; Cosmic Horror and Body Horror tags).
Intense same-sex closeness; some horror scenes read as metaphors for sex; creator calls it queer but not a romance (Wikipedia; CSM; BL and LGBTQ+ tags).
Mild profanity in the anime adaptation (CSM).
An adult smokes; background drinking (CSM, anime).
Suicides occur in the story; grief is the core theme (Wikipedia; CSM; Tragedy tag).
Keeping a dangerous secret from adults.
Bestselling franchise with anime and light novels.

dominant: Existentialism, Pagan/occult (folk curses), Progressivism (queer identity in a conservative town)
